title.zh: OpenAI Feared "Optics" of what might appear on Hacker News
title.en: OpenAI Feared "Optics" of what might appear on Hacker News

current_state.zh: Newly unsealed filings in the Authors Guild v. OpenAI case quote an OpenAI researcher worrying about the 'optics' of training on copyrighted books from a 'sketchy Russian website' appearing on Hacker News, indicating top executives knew the mass book piracy was likely illegal.
